scope: Bounded archival and implementation review of the CABQ Council District Poster Map and NTMP Request Process Flowchart

candidates.title: Council District Poster Map
candidates.reason_for_size: A print-resolution, citywide poster map containing detailed district boundaries, streets, labels, inset geography, and nine councilor portraits.
candidates.optimization_notes: No derivative is proposed. Preserve the original print-resolution PDF because map detail and legibility are fidelity-sensitive.
candidates.current_version_check: A CABQ ArcGIS organization search returned this as the sole Council District Poster Map item; the dated January 2026 edition remains the publisher's current poster-map record.
candidates.visual_review: The complete one-page map rendered successfully at full resolution; district boundaries, street labels, legend portraits, scale, north arrow, inset map, and January 2026 production note were intact and legible.

candidates.title: NTMP Request Process Flowchart
candidates.reason_for_size: A high-resolution infographic designed to keep eligibility rules, decision branches, estimated timelines, funding steps, and traffic-calming options readable.
candidates.optimization_notes: No derivative is proposed. Preserve the original PNG because its text-heavy layout benefits from the full published resolution.
candidates.current_version_check: CABQ ArcGIS organization searches found only this NTMP request-process flowchart; related current NTMP maps and dashboards are distinct resources rather than successors.
candidates.visual_review: The complete infographic was visually intact and legible, including request eligibility, review, 48-hour study, report, design, funding, scheduling, construction, and recommended treatment steps.

decision: Implement both current official files with their CABQ ArcGIS source-item links; retain both candidates for explicit R2 archival authorization.
